profile.headline: Mr Silly | Custom ERP Dev | .NET Dev | Salesforce Dev
profile.summary:
I've been writing software for 30 years. My hobbies are everything. I do almost everything in tech and I'm even halfway decent at it. I believe the future of tech isn't depth (specialist) but rather horizontal (polymath). My specialty, however, is creating custom ERP/CRM/PMS systems for businesses written in C# utilizing Angular/React.

That's my day job and career. Since 2020 I have been putting pen to paper and developing my own comprehensive philosophical system wherein I have a religious text, a philosophy of ethics and morality, and my own metaphysics.

company.name: Some College You Haven't Heard Of

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Played a crucial role in the RapidIdentity Idp/IAM system upgrade project that required the upgrade, management, and setup of 40+ SSO partners.• Appointed as administrator for RapidIdentity Idp/IAM system in which I maintained and coded jobs and triggers in RI and oversaw and implemented integrations.
• Updated and managed Salesforce instance that admits over 1000 students per semester.
• Modified existing legacy .Net 4.6 Web API and associated domain code. 
• Worked with multiple vendors to bi-directionally send and receive data via Rest API in  Salesforce. 
• Created AI chat bot utilizing Llama 3.2 as a base, and RAG search with Postgres db.  
• Wrote Python scripts to fine tune LLM responses utilizingHuggingface and datasets from interviews from multi-department personnel. 
• Created an internal React and .NET 10 API “queue” application to be used by multiple departments that help service students of varying needs by allowing them to “queue” into virtual line.
• Configured and managed a Team City build server that ran tests and deployed to three different staged instances of IIS.
• Worked TeamDynamics tickets associated with Salesforce/.NET applications and tickets that overlapped with enterprise applications, networking issues, and RapidIdenity IAM  issues.
• Served as the lead for upgrading the enterprise Student Information System (SIS) to a cloud variant; upgrading API from 4.6 to .NET 10, tracked report utilization, database migration, integrated vendor API calls, and created a dozen “worker” applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
This was a 50-50 developer and business analyst role. I was brought in to determine the root cause of many of the issues of a scrap management inventory system they used and to support it through maintaining, upgrading, and integrating hardware and software. I got executive approval to create a custom ERP/Scrap system in-house, but the project was later halted, then they laid off half the company.
• Interviewed over 30 employees - from executives to floor operators – to gain KPI metrics as to the effectiveness of the current scrap management system.
• Visited multiple facilities to document processes from intake to selling material to foundries.
• Led prototype development of an internal scrap management system.
• Designed and developed 17+ .NET Core microservices and deployed an Angular 18 frontend for the new in-house scrap management system.
• Built and configured Azure Kubernetes architecture with vNet peering and private DNS.
• Scripted Kubernetes YAML for services, ingresses, and deployments for microservices.
• Configured GitLab pipelines to generate Docker images.
• Administered existing scrap management system and worked Jira tickets to resolve data issues, user permissions, or report failures.
• Worked with operations managers and corporate executives to determine the impact on operations costs based on deployment windows for upgrading the existing scrap system.
• Coordinated and implemented on-site tech deployments, including camera installs, Zebra printers, scales, and ran cabling for a 10,000 sq ft facility.
• Coordinated and lead bi-weekly meetings with existing scrap management vendor and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues with the system.

positions.title: IT Manager/.NET Developer
positions.description:
This was a 50-50 developer and IT Manager role. I was brought in after half the company, including the programmer, was let go in the pandemic. I modernized their on- premises IT infrastructure and modernized their aged internal ERP system.
• Owned IT operations and software development for three facilities post-COVID  downsizing. 
• Managed vendors, infrastructure, in-house ERP, and three IT helpdesk staff. 
• Rebuilt internal ERP from VB6 to C#/Angular, automating operations and increasing  process efficiency by 60%. 
• Developed 75+ applications to automate quality checks, document workflows, and  financial integrations.
• Identified quality issues with rental equipment which led to the creation of a mobile application that allowed the company to track equipment over its lifecycle. 
• Designed a MSSQL-based data warehouse and Metabase dashboards, cutting manual  reporting hours by 80%. 
• Oversaw the transition from point-to-point (PtP) networking connecting multiple warehouses to Versa Networks SD-WAN that bridged three warehouses over multiple city blocks.
• Modernized on-prem infrastructure with Hyper-V, new Juniper switches, and SD-WAN, improving network reliability considerably. 
• Rolled out VOIP solution for 100+ endpoints and resolved SD-WAN SIP issues, cutting  telecom bill by $8000 a year. 
• Integrated Quickbooks on-premise into ERP database. 
• Built Hyper-V Virtualization Servers - primary and failover.
• Rolled out Malware Bytes EDR to over 170 workstations and servers.
• Implemented Acronis Cloud backups for servers, executive workstations, and bottleneck workstations.
• Oversaw and and guided offshore teams in creating online store with Magento/Adobe Commerce.
• Implemented and integrated ShipStation into custom ERP used for online orders.
• Identified bottleneck in manufacturing which led to the creation of a “tag room” that optimized throughput.
• Met daily with top executive team members to give status reports and receive direction.

positions.title: Salesforce / .NET Developer
positions.description:
Mogas is the Cadillac of ball valves and serves a dozen verticals such as petrochemical and autoclave. I was brought in to maintain existing software and develop new ways of gathering data for process improvement.
• Saved the company $400,000+ in consulting and development fees by leading in-house Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud implementation.
• Led interviews to gather requirements across the company for integrating Syteline ERP • Integrated Salesforce and Syteline ERP via REST APIs, enabling real-time KPI dashboards for executives.
• Designed and developed a custom online ordering system, increasing customer engagement and reducing calls to sales personnel to retrieve old order details.
• Maintained and enhanced 30+ internal applications written in C# and VB.NET.

positions.title: Senior Solutions Developer
positions.description:
Conifer is a revenue cycle arm of its parent company Tenet. I was brought in to maintain and support an existing 24/7 critical patient care application and perform a “digital face-lift” of existing tools and processes.
• Spearheaded a Jira Service Desk implementation with a Business Analyst, which was used by 10,000+ users across multiple departments in child and parent hospital systems.
• Led multiple healthcare app projects and DevOps initiatives with two junior developers.
• Implemented continuous integration with TFS, New Relic code analysis, and Octopus Deploy for automated deployments between tiered release environments.
• Migrated 17 codebases from SVN to Git, and implemented CI/CD using Azure DevOps and Octopus Deploy.
• Supported and developed a critical patient tracking application written in C# and ASP.NET.
